'''Business and economy'''
*[[2022–2023 food crises]]
**[[Supermarket]]s in the [[United Kingdom]], such as [[Asda]] and [[Morrisons]], begin [[rationing]] fruit and vegetables, citing poor harvests in [[Spain]] and [[North Africa]], and a [[agriculture in the United Kingdom|domestic farming]] crisis. The [[shortages]] are expected to last several weeks. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/business/2023/02/21/ftse-100-markets-public-sector-finances-data-ons-live-news-uk/ (''The Telegraph'')] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022–23 South-West Indian Ocean cyclone season]]
**[[Cyclone Freddy]] makes landfall in [[Madagascar]], killing at least four people. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/death-toll-cyclone-freddy-madagascar-rises-4-govt-2023-02-22/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Philippine Air Force]] and [[Philippine Navy|Navy]] locate on [[Mayon Volcano]], [[Albay]], the debris of a [[Cessna 340]] aircraft that went missing after [[Takeoff|taking off]] from [[Daraga]] for [[Manila]] on February 18. However, the whereabouts of the two pilots and two [[Australians|Australian]] passengers on board have yet to be located due to inclement weather. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/philippines-missing-plane-4-aboard-crashed-volcano-97349787 (AP via ABC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russia–United States relations]], [[Russia and weapons of mass destruction]]
**[[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] suspends [[Russia]]'s participation in the [[New START]] treaty, the last remaining [[nuclear weapon|nuclear arms]] control pact with the [[United States]], citing the U.S.'s goal of defeating Russia in [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|the ongoing war in Ukraine]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-putin-politics-government-united-states-23cc21a1f42798177a40d4e53204b054 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[He Jiankui affair]]
**The [[Immigration Department (Hong Kong)|Immigration Department]] of [[Hong Kong]] [[Visa policy of Hong Kong|cancels]] [[Mainland Chinese|Chinese]] scientist [[He Jiankui]]'s [[work permit]] and initiates a [[criminal investigation]] into his failure to declare a three-year prison [[sentence (law)|sentence]] over his [[Bioethics|unethical]] [[genome editing]] research conduct while applying for the permit. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2023/02/22/world/he-jiankui-hong-kong/ (AFP via ''The Japan Times'')]
*A 17-year-old male student at [[Matanzas High School]] viciously attacks a teacher due to being told not to use the [[Nintendo Switch]] during class. The student knocks the teacher unconscious. The student faces battery charges and is to be tried as an adult. [https://www.nbcmiami.com/news/local/teen-in-vicious-attack-on-florida-teachers-aide-to-be-charged-as-adult-given-1m-bond (MBC Miami)]
